heading: The write
text:
### The write [NSTG.3.1]

A rule stores a fact by calling `record_fact` ([LSTO.2.2.1]), so the
facts plane rides on the call callback ([NCBK.6]). The call's one argument is the fact, of kind `DS_ARG_ENCODED_FACT`
([NCBK.6.10]). The store reads it back to the engine only through a hydration
([NSTG.4.3]).
